cooked: The parity factor seems to be missing from the protocol equations. In the shared interface, the secret for the input key is a=\sum_i (g c_i)k_i+\tau, but the protocol computes C=\sum_i[c_i]D_i+[\tau]B and aggregates responses with c_i z_i. Unless the protocol’s c_i already means g times the original coefficient, those equations prove knowledge of the wrong discrete log when g=-1.
